thread:
nora: FYI GulfEdge reached out to list an ae-dubai marketplace SKU that bundles their SI install + local HSM. they want entitlement + quota + KMS/HSM routing confirmed. pilot target in 3 weeks.
hamid: do we have a partner SKU name? and HSM type? will their HSM be onsite or cloud HSM?
nora: placeholder SKU: GULFED-AE-DXB-HS-01. partner says it's cloud-HSM (partner-managed HSM instance) with an option to move to customer-managed HSM later.
alesha: ops note: Dubai region needs at least 6 H100-equivalent GPUs, 48 vCPU control-plane, and 4TB egress/mo baseline. also private-link peering with GulfEdge SI.
yara_legal: legal: prefer customer-managed keys for production. for pilot we can accept partner-managed HSM if MOA includes key custody and breach-notify clauses. add clause for HSM cert rotation and audit logs access.
hamid: network asks: will GulfEdge require cross-account peering or a partner VPN? need ASNs and IP ranges to file peering.
nora: partner prefers cross-account peering + dedicated subnet per SI. they will share ASN after NDA. I'm drafting the NDA tonight.
alesha: ops checklist: (1) quota bump request for GPUs/vCPU/egress, (2) subnet carve + peering, (3) HSM routing diagram + cert lifecycle. can someone volunteer to own HSM diagram?
yara_legal: I can own the MOA redlines and HSM clauses. please add the HSM flow to the ticket.
devops-bot: ticket created: MKP-7982 - ae-dubai entitlement + HSM flow (assignee: alesha). ETA: 2026-08-12.
nora: marketing wants co-branded launch brief but prefers announcement after pilot. partner asked for a joint blog and webinar if pilot metrics meet SLA.
hamid: ops question: autoscaler min 2 / max 12 GPUs ok? suggests reserve 6 for pilot and allow scale to 12 on demand.
alesha: confirmed autoscaler min 2 max 12; committed pool 6 GPUs. I'll submit quota escalation once we lock numbers.
nora: ok quick decision: reply with "+pilot-hsm" to allow partner-managed HSM for pilot with MOA appendix, or "+req-byok" to insist customer-managed HSM even for pilot. need by EOD Tue to keep timeline.
hamid: +pilot-hsm (speeds onboarding; ops can capture rotation logs)
yara_legal: +req-byok (legal would rather BYOK; partner must justify inability to BYOK)
alesha: +pilot-hsm (we can automate a 30d transition plan in the MOA)
nora: thanks team. I'll intro GulfEdge PM (@sultan_gulfedge) after NDA and attach ticket. reminder: entitlement sync scheduled 2026-08-10 16:00 GST (calendar invite sent).
